## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix failure-report matching so a `./` prefix cannot cause a requested failing test to be skipped.

## Changes

The pull request adds a failure-report selector and rewrites the cached selector’s filter. It adds tests for explicit, cached, and failure-report selection.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before matching — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns an empty selection when the request contains `tests/test_x.py`. Both existing selectors normalize candidate paths before matching, while the new selector compares the raw report path. — A rerun can omit a test the caller explicitly requested after it failed. — Fix: Apply `normalize(path)` in the membership check, preserve `path` in the result, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.

## Suggestions

- app/selection.py:15 — tests — Test exclusion of unrequested cached paths — The cached-selector test supplies only `./tests/test_x.py`, which matches the request after normalization. The test would pass if the rewritten filter also retained unrequested paths. — The suite would miss a regression that causes cache-based runs to execute extra tests.
